title: Annotated interictal epileptiform discharges in intracranial EEG (iEEG) sleep data (Falach et al., 2024)
description: This dataset contains multichannel intracranial EEG (iEEG) recordings from 25 epilepsy patients during overnight sleep, collected at two medical centers (Tel Aviv Sourasky Medical Center and UCLA). It includes 852 interictal epileptiform discharges annotated by expert neurologists, primarily in the medial temporal lobe. Short sleep excerpts are provided in BIDS format with electrode information, seizure onset zone, and sleep scoring, supporting development and benchmarking of automated IED detection methods.
methods_description: Depth-electrode iEEG was recorded with a Blackrock system during sleep in epilepsy patients undergoing clinical monitoring. Expert neurologists annotated interictal epileptiform discharges. Data were resampled to 1000 Hz and shared as EDF files (61 to 291 s excerpts), with sleep stages scored per AASM criteria and electrode coordinates in MNI space for a subset of participants.
